_about: ID8 layout A (reference photo 3): every position is normalized to the 1920x720 calibration grid (x / 1920, y / 720); radii are px of that grid. Measured on design/refs/id8/A.png (the photo straightened on the backlit panel's corners). Edit here, then: python3 cluster/tools/gen_static.py id8/A

bracket_left._about: The blue speed bracket's outer profile, from the end of its top line round the apex, then straight along y 635 past the 0 to where the light band ends at x 510 (the darker band and glow below are the shadow, drawn later). Legs fitted on the photo's pixels (max error 1.1 px): upper x = -0.5911 y + 346.31, lower x = 0.5755 y - 25.78; the right bracket is its mirror about x 0.5 (checked later on the red one).
bracket_left._about_inner: The bracket's inner profile: parallel to the outer one (upper x = -0.594 y + 447.9, lower x = 0.581 y + 42.2), the band wider above the apex (~100 px across) than below it (~71 px); at the top it turns level onto the top line itself (y 118), so the top is one single line to x 665; at the bottom it runs level at y 625 to x 510 and the slanted end cut (510,625)-(507,635) closes the 10 px foot.
bracket_left._about_parallel: The parallel just inside the outer profile: the inner edge of the light outer stripe (15 px thick across on the upper leg, 11 on the lower; upper x = -0.5911 y + 363.7, lower x = 0.5755 y - 13.1, measured square to the legs on the photo), from the top line down to y 625 and on along the foot's top edge to the inner profile. The graduated marks sit in the dark gap just inside it.

ticks._about: The graduated marks: one short level dash per number, in the dark gap just inside the parallel (from the parallel + start to + start + length, px), at the photo's heights. The scale is not even in value: 60 km/h per mark above 150, 30 below, the marks ~56 / ~59 px apart. 60, 30 and 0 sit in the lit part of the photo: their heights follow the 59 px spacing (60 found at 495). Two full scales on the same marks, chosen in the app: 330 (30 km/h a step to 150, then 60) and 260 (20 a step to 60, then 40); a speed's height comes from its two neighbouring marks of the chosen scale. In mph: 200 (20 a step to 120, then 40) for the 330 km/h scale and 160 (20 a step) for the 260.

bracket_left._about_band: The blue band's outer edge, just right of the graduated marks: 33 px in from the outer profile across the upper leg, 27 across the lower (upper x = -0.5911 y + 384.6, lower x = 0.5755 y + 5.3), from the top line to y 625 and on along the foot to the inner profile. Between it and the inner profile is the band that fills light blue up to the speed (drawn last, it moves).

colors._about: RGB medians of the photo inside each zone, on the upper legs (the lower part of the photo is lit by the speed fill).

bevel._about: The 3D look, as a brightness profile across each zone (t: 0 at its outer edge, 1 at its inner edge), multiplying the zone's colour. stripe: a tube, 'edge' at both rims rising to 1 in the middle, plus a glossy highlight of 'gloss' (added towards white) centred at t 'gloss_at', 'gloss_w' wide. band: a hollow, 'edge' at the gap side rising to 1 over 'rise' of its width, falling to 'inner' just before the inner line. soft: px over which every edge is feathered.

numbers._about: The scale's numbers, BMW's squared digits drawn as shapes (tools/gen_static.py DIGITS, measured on the photo's 330 / 270 / 150 / 60 / 30: 22 px tall, 29 wide, the 1 18 wide, uprights 6.5 thick, bars 4, digits 32.5 apart), right-aligned 'gap' px left of the outer profile at each mark's height, centred on it. 'scale' picks the scale (ticks.scales).

label_speed_unit._about: The speed scale's unit over the bracket: the ink of the text fits the photo's box (x 306-364, y 90-111: 'k' and 'h' tops to the baseline), left-aligned; with an mph scale the text is 'mph' at the same height. Barlow Semi Condensed Medium, a touch heavier ('bold') (SIL OFL, tools/fonts-src).
